Name: Chocolate Valley and Domed Garden Pots Compatibility
Author: MariesaMist
Description:
This compatibility patch replaces the machine file 
[CP] Domed Garden Pot\Data 
Click "Machine" and DELETE
Then move the new Machine folder in to replace it.


Note, there is no difference for the crop after the Cinder upgrade, so save your resources, (other then Stellar, which I dropped the regrow time to 1 day :D)

Also, Optional file with all the individiual Pots, so that if you need to insert them into an already changed data file, you can!

Downloads.Description: Replace the Data/Machine file in Domed for this to work

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it contains files, but none of them are manifest.json.

Downloads.Description: This is to individually copy and paste the modifications in, if you have an already modified version of Domed Garden Pots
